statusDetail: All 58 catalog checks were judged. Repeated 503 responses are site findings; Lighthouse was unavailable, so raw CDP, trace, layout, axe, DOM and custom probes supplied equivalent evidence.

page.notes: Public Hindi adult-media listing. Representative homepage, categories, search, signup, and failure paths were inspected. A video detail/player and authenticated account/checkout were not covered because the site repeatedly rate-limited route requests and no stable detail URL was exposed in the captured links.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Default light-condition and emulated dark screenshots remain visually identical dark surfaces; the captured CSS has only two color-scheme media matches and the rendered surface does not retint.
Eight animations remained running with 2000 ms durations under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, and no reduced-motion CSS rule was found.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated contrast screenshot, CSS inspection, and axe contrast analysis
checkOutcomes.evidence: No prefers-contrast or forced-colors rule was found; axe reported serious contrast failures including 1.75:1 and 2.15:1 text combinations.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM/CSS inspection and cross-document path walkthrough
checkOutcomes.evidence: Navigation between homepage, categories, signup, and failure surfaces is abrupt, and no same-document or cross-document view-transition rule was found.
No decorative scroll-linked animation was present, so a scroll timeline is not needed.
checkOutcomes.reason: No decorative scroll-linked animation was present, so a scroll timeline is not needed.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited listing, search, and signup surfaces do not expose a swipe, drag, carousel, or other physical-gesture task.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited listing, search, and signup surfaces do not expose a swipe, drag, carousel, or other physical-gesture task.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The page has a long feed and persistent navigation, but no scroll-state query or other state-aware chrome behavior was found in the captured CSS.
The only observed overlay was a centered consent modal, not an element anchored to a trigger or edge-sensitive target.
checkOutcomes.reason: The only observed overlay was a centered consent modal, not an element anchored to a trigger or edge-sensitive target.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The H1, active Video tab, search control, categories, and content cards provide clear visual and semantic attention cues.
A large consent overlay appears before interaction and obscures most of the homepage, category page, signup page, and 404 content.
The visible consent overlay is absent from dialog, role=dialog, aria-modal, popover, and details inventories, indicating custom non-semantic overlay handling.
The fixed top navigation, 200 px sidebar, banners, and blocking consent surface leave a minority of the mobile viewport for primary content.

checkOutcomes.method: Layout primitive at 360x800 and mobile screenshot
checkOutcomes.evidence: At a 360 px visual viewport the document reports 1030 px content width and 670 px horizontal overflow, clipping most content.
No @container rule was present in the captured CSS, and the desktop feed/sidebar composition remains 1030 px wide on mobile.

checkOutcomes.method: Programmatic keyboard focus and computed-style probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: The first visible link receives outline-style none and no box-shadow after focus, leaving keyboard focus without a visible indicator.

checkOutcomes.method: First-viewport screenshot, H1, nav and form inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The Hindi H1 identifies trending free videos, search is prominent, and content/navigation labels make the page purpose clear.
Submitting the prominent search form with “test” navigated to /?q=test but returned a generic 503 page rather than results.
Failure states are a bare nginx 503 with no Hindi explanation, retry control, navigation, or recovery action.
The successful trace measured FCP/LCP 1511.67 ms and TBT 127.54 ms; layout observation measured CLS 0.

checkOutcomes.method: Layout shift observer and image inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: The measured load had CLS 0 with no recorded shifts, although missing image dimensions are reported separately as an asset hygiene risk.
The trace found two long tasks, longest 150.56 ms, with 127.54 ms total blocking time, acceptable for this load but worth monitoring.

checkOutcomes.method: Image primitive and successful CDP network probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Thirteen images were over 2x displayed size, 29 lacked dimensions, and a successful load initiated 136 resources across many origins.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered DOM/CSS and successful network inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: The captured successful page used deferred scripts and no direct duplicate-code signal was observed in the authored resource inventory; confidence is low because Lighthouse code coverage was unavailable.
axe found serious aria-hidden-focus, prohibited ARIA, and nested-interactive violations; the custom probe also found unnamed controls and image links.
Axe reported serious WCAG AA contrast failures, including 1.75:1 secondary banner text and repeated 3.29:1 metadata text.

checkOutcomes.method: axe-core landmark analysis and keyboard focus probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Axe found non-unique and nested landmarks, while computed focus styling was outline none with no replacement shadow.

checkOutcomes.method: Desktop screenshot and heading/text CSS inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Primary headings and card titles are visibly legible at desktop size with clear weight and spacing; contrast defects are recorded separately.
The page declares a scalable viewport but does not reflow: content remains 1030 px wide in a 360 px visual viewport.

checkOutcomes.method: Raw CDP Runtime and Log event capture
checkOutcomes.evidence: A successful page load logged a 503 for the search-history API and an identity-provider sign-in error.
Doctype, UTF-8, and viewport are sound, but 29 of 36 images lack explicit width/height and one image lacks alt text.
No on-load geolocation or notification prompt, paste prevention, or deprecated interactive API was observed; the document uses standard HTML controls for search.
A descriptive Hindi title and meta description are present in both rendered and raw HTML.

checkOutcomes.method: Discoverability primitive and 360 px layout test
checkOutcomes.evidence: Raw content is crawlable, but the mobile-friendly part fails with 670 px horizontal overflow at a 360 px viewport.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM, robots.txt, status and canonical inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The entry document returned 200, exposes a canonical URL and robots.txt, and has no noindex signal; the sitemap endpoint was intermittently 503 but indexing of the entry page remains signaled.
No JSON-LD and no Open Graph metadata were present on the representative homepage.
HTTPS is used and no client secret was found, but CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy are all absent.

checkOutcomes.method: Successful CDP network probe and consent screenshot
checkOutcomes.evidence: Before consent resolution, a successful load initiated 136 resources including collector, Google, tsyndicate, flixcdn, and multiple CDN origins.

checkOutcomes.method: Fresh-profile interaction and signup surface inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: No browser permission prompt fired on load; account entry is user-initiated from signup/login controls rather than forced.
All defensive policy headers were absent; settings and CSRF cookies were reported without Secure, and settings used SameSite=None.
The server returns substantive HTML: 67% of rendered content words, title, H1, and description survive without JavaScript, and it is not a JS shell.

checkOutcomes.method: Repeated route loads and console/network capture
checkOutcomes.evidence: Normal route and API requests intermittently return 503, producing brittle runtime behavior despite an otherwise rendered shell.
Offline media playback or installation is not necessary for the public streaming/listing task; service-worker support exists but offline behavior was not treated as a requirement.
checkOutcomes.reason: Offline media playback or installation is not necessary for the public streaming/listing task; service-worker support exists but offline behavior was not treated as a requirement.

checkOutcomes.method: Search submission and repeated route failure tests
checkOutcomes.evidence: Search, signup, category, manifest, sitemap, and unknown-route requests intermittently returned a bare nginx 503 with no retry or stale-data fallback.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM language and CSS property inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The Hindi document has lang=hi, but captured CSS contains roughly 173 physical left/right declarations and only one logical-property match, limiting robust bidirectional adaptation.
Navigation, consent, headings, category names, and counts are presented consistently in the Hindi locale.
No date, schedule, recurring event, or time-zone-sensitive value appears in the audited paths.
checkOutcomes.reason: No date, schedule, recurring event, or time-zone-sensitive value appears in the audited paths.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Accept and reject are presented side by side with equal visual weight, and the copy links to cookie and privacy policies.
The failed primary search returns an infrastructure error rather than contextual, humane language and a recovery action.

checkOutcomes.method: Search and signup form DOM inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The prominent search field explicitly sets autocomplete=off, preventing useful browser assistance for repeated searches.
The signup entry is explicit, uses an email sign-up action, and does not expose hidden pricing or forced subscription in the inspected entry state; deeper authenticated flows were not available.
Thirteen images are oversized, 15 use legacy formats, 29 omit intrinsic dimensions, and eight below-fold images are not lazy-loaded.
The trace showed only two bounded long tasks and the repeated scroll test ended around 24.6 MB used JS heap with 1,916 DOM nodes; no runaway idle work was observed.

checkOutcomes.method: Successful CDP network inventory and images primitive
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page initiated 136 resources across at least 13 origins, including ad/identity origins, while multiple thumbnails were oversized or legacy-format.
This public media browser exposes no transactional agent task that requires WebMCP tools; conventional crawlable links and search remain the appropriate interface.
checkOutcomes.reason: This public media browser exposes no transactional agent task that requires WebMCP tools; conventional crawlable links and search remain the appropriate interface.

checkOutcomes.method: Built-in AI usage inspection and site-purpose judgement
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page has no summarisation, translation-generation, or other user task that requires on-device inference.
checkOutcomes.reason: The page has no summarisation, translation-generation, or other user task that requires on-device inference.

checkOutcomes.method: Baseline/post Performance.memory and repeated-scroll heap sampling
checkOutcomes.evidence: Across successful fresh sessions, used JS heap was about 22.7 MB at baseline and 24.6 MB after ten end-to-end scroll cycles; this bounded change does not show a retained-growth leak.
The exercised page used about 24.6 MB JS heap with 1,916 live DOM nodes after repeated scrolling, proportionate to a media feed.

checkOutcomes.method: Heap constructor summary and DOM/animation count after repeated interaction
checkOutcomes.evidence: The post-scroll heap summary contains no Detached constructor entry and the exercised state remained at 1,916 DOM nodes and 12 animations; confidence is low because listener instrumentation was unavailable.

paths.description: Homepage/listing template and primary search entry. Tested desktop, dark, contrast, reduced motion, mobile, accessibility, network, performance, security, discoverability and memory.
Categories/index archetype, representing taxonomy navigation and content browsing.
Primary search journey by filling and submitting the homepage search form.
Signup/account-entry archetype reached from the main menu.
Unknown route and repeated 503 failure/recovery behavior.

findings.summary: Theme does not follow the OS color preference
findings.evidence: Default and dark-emulated screenshots show the same dark palette, so light-preferring users are not respected.
findings.suggestedFix: Use color-scheme: light dark and preference-driven light-dark() tokens while retaining an explicit user override.

findings.summary: Motion continues under reduced-motion preference
findings.evidence: Eight 2-second animations remained active under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a reduced-motion media query that removes non-essential animation and shortens essential transitions.

findings.summary: Contrast preferences and baseline contrast are not supported
findings.evidence: No forced-colors/prefers-contrast adaptation was found, and axe measured text as low as 1.75:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Use system colors in forced-colors mode and adjust design tokens to meet WCAG AA in normal and high-contrast modes.

findings.summary: Long-page navigation does not adapt to scroll state
findings.evidence: The long feed has persistent chrome but no scroll-state-aware adaptation.
findings.suggestedFix: Use scroll-state container queries or a lightweight sticky-header state to preserve orientation without consuming excess space.

findings.summary: Consent interrupts every primary path
findings.evidence: The fresh-profile consent surface obscures most content before any user action.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce the consent surface, keep essential content usable, and reserve blocking presentation only where legally required.

findings.summary: Consent overlay is not exposed as a semantic dialog
findings.evidence: The visible modal has no dialog element, dialog role, aria-modal, or popover semantics.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement the surface with dialog/showModal() and platform focus, Escape, and inert-background behavior.

findings.summary: Persistent chrome crowds out content
findings.evidence: Top navigation, sidebar, banners, and consent leave little mobile space for the core feed.
findings.suggestedFix: Collapse secondary navigation at narrow sizes and prioritize the content/search journey.

findings.summary: Mobile layout overflows by 670 px
findings.evidence: The 360 px viewport renders a 1030 px document, clipping most of the feed.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace fixed/minimum widths with fluid intrinsic layout and verify no horizontal overflow at 320 to 400 px.

findings.summary: Components retain desktop geometry on mobile
findings.evidence: The desktop sidebar/feed remains 1030 px wide and no container query was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Give feed components containment and adapt card/sidebar composition with size-aware container queries and a media-query fallback.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is visually hidden
findings.evidence: Focused interactive content computes outline-style none with no replacement shadow.
findings.suggestedFix: Use :focus-visible with a high-contrast outline that is not removed by hover or reset styles.

findings.summary: Primary search flow ends in 503
findings.evidence: Submitting the main search for test returned a generic nginx 503.
findings.suggestedFix: Make search requests resilient, preserve the query, and render a retryable in-page error rather than replacing the document.

findings.summary: Failure states provide no recovery
findings.evidence: The 503 page has no localized explanation, retry, back, or home action.
findings.suggestedFix: Render a localized error state with retry, safe navigation, and preserved task context.

findings.summary: Resource delivery wastes image bytes
findings.evidence: Thirteen images exceed 2x display dimensions and 29 omit intrinsic dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate right-sized AVIF/WebP variants, use srcset/sizes, reserve dimensions, and prioritize only the LCP candidate.

findings.summary: Serious names, roles, and nesting defects
findings.evidence: Axe found focusable content inside aria-hidden, prohibited ARIA, and nested interactive controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove hidden controls from focus, assign valid native roles/names, and avoid interactive descendants inside role=button containers.

findings.summary: Text contrast falls below WCAG AA
findings.evidence: Axe measured several combinations between 1.75:1 and 4.04:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise foreground/background contrast through shared tokens and test all metadata, banners, and active states to AA.

findings.summary: Landmarks and focus structure impede navigation
findings.evidence: Axe found non-unique/nested landmarks and keyboard focus has no visible indicator.
findings.suggestedFix: Label repeated nav/aside landmarks, keep complementary landmarks top-level, and restore focus-visible styling.

findings.summary: The interface does not reflow at mobile width
findings.evidence: A 360 px viewport still receives a 1030 px layout.
findings.suggestedFix: Use fluid sizing, wrapping/grid minmax(), and test zoom/reflow without two-dimensional scrolling.

findings.summary: Successful loads still emit console errors
findings.evidence: The search-history API returns 503 and identity integration logs an error for signed-out visitors.
findings.suggestedFix: Handle expected signed-out states silently and make optional API failures non-erroring with fallback behavior.

findings.summary: Image asset markup lacks dimensions and complete alternatives
findings.evidence: 29 of 36 images omit width/height and one image has no alt.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic dimensions or aspect-ratio for every image and add an appropriate alternative or empty alt for decoration.

findings.summary: Crawlable page is not mobile-friendly
findings.evidence: Server HTML is visible to crawlers, but the rendered mobile layout has 670 px overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep semantic links and metadata while rebuilding the layout with fluid sizing for mobile indexing.

findings.summary: Pages lack structured and social metadata
findings.evidence: No JSON-LD or Open Graph tags were found.
findings.suggestedFix: Add content-accurate schema.org JSON-LD and Open Graph/Twitter metadata to representative templates.

findings.summary: Core security headers are absent
findings.evidence: CSP, HSTS, nosniff, clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy are missing.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, and least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Third-party requests begin before consent resolution
findings.evidence: The fresh load contacts collector, Google, ad, media, and multiple CDN origins while consent is still blocking the page.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate non-essential analytics/ad calls on consent, minimize vendors, and batch only necessary telemetry.

findings.summary: Cookies and browser policies are weak
findings.evidence: Two cookies lack Secure, settings uses SameSite=None, and defensive headers are absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark HTTPS cookies Secure, use the strictest workable SameSite/HttpOnly attributes, and add defensive response policies.

findings.summary: Runtime dependencies fail intermittently
findings.evidence: Repeated successful shell loads include 503 API failures and whole routes intermittently return 503.
findings.suggestedFix: Isolate optional dependencies, cache stable shell/data, and degrade failed modules without breaking navigation.

findings.summary: Network and HTTP failures are not resilient
findings.evidence: Several routes and APIs return a bare nginx 503 without retry or stale data.
findings.suggestedFix: Add application-level timeout/error states, retries with backoff, stale content, and a branded recoverable 5xx page.

findings.summary: Localized CSS relies heavily on physical directions
findings.evidence: Captured CSS uses roughly 173 left/right declarations versus one logical-property match.
findings.suggestedFix: Migrate layout and spacing to margin/padding/inset inline/block logical properties and test RTL locales.

findings.summary: Infrastructure errors are not humane
findings.evidence: Search failure replaces the task with an English nginx error.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep the user in context, announce a localized error, preserve input, and offer retry and cancel/back actions.

findings.summary: Search disables browser input assistance
findings.evidence: The main query field sets autocomplete=off.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow search-history assistance where appropriate, using a meaningful autocomplete token or leaving autocomplete enabled.

findings.summary: Media assets are not consistently optimized
findings.evidence: The image audit found oversized, legacy-format, dimensionless, and eagerly loaded below-fold assets.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt responsive AVIF/WebP sources, intrinsic dimensions, and lazy loading for non-LCP media.

findings.summary: Third-party and media footprint is broad
findings.evidence: A successful load made 136 requests across at least 13 origins, with additional oversized thumbnails.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a page-weight/vendor budget, remove non-essential vendors, defer background fetches, and right-size media.

findings.summary: Navigation changes are abrupt
findings.evidence: Representative cross-document navigation has no view-transition treatment.
findings.suggestedFix: Use cross-document view transitions as progressive enhancement for stable shared chrome and directionally clear route changes.

taskList.title: Rebuild the mobile composition with fluid sizing and container-aware components so 320 to 400 px viewports never overflow.
Make search, route, and API failures recoverable with in-context localized errors, retry, preserved input, and resilient optional dependencies.
Repair accessibility semantics, landmarks, focus visibility, and contrast using shared accessible control and color tokens.
Deploy defensive security headers, harden cookies, and defer non-essential third-party calls until valid consent.
Optimize image delivery with right-sized modern responsive sources, intrinsic dimensions, alternatives, and lazy loading.
Replace the blocking custom consent layer with a smaller semantic dialog and reduce persistent navigation chrome.
Respect color and motion preferences with preference-driven theme tokens, forced-color support, and reduced motion.
Add accurate JSON-LD and social preview metadata to each representative public template.
Migrate layout CSS from physical left/right declarations to logical inline/block properties and test RTL.
Add progressive scroll-state and cross-document transition treatment to preserve orientation on long-page navigation.
Allow appropriate browser assistance in the primary search field instead of disabling autocomplete.
